output.instruction: Find each screwdriver-use cycle on the fixture, anchored by visible turning. For each turning episode, require an observed transition where the operator engages the screwdriver at a screw position on the fixture before turning, followed by withdrawal from the same position. Merely holding an already engaged screwdriver is not an observed engagement transition. Mark partial cycles and uncertain or unobserved steps or identities as needs-review, including engagement outside the clip; unobserved does not mean absent. Use a maximum cycle duration of 40 seconds, a maximum gap between steps of 5 seconds, and zero overlap tolerance. Select all cycles and create full-frame clips and a timestamped report.

output.explanation: Each cycle is anchored by observed visible turning with required engage-before-turning-then-withdrawal order at the same screw position on the fixture. Engage requires an observed transition, not static holding. Cycle limits are 40s total, 5s max gap, 0 overlap. Partial, uncertain, or unobserved steps or identities are needs-review, not absent. All cycles are selected with full-frame clips and a timestamped report.
